Mirror docs

The mirror keeps its pages under a directory of its own: read the first guide and the second guide, or jump to the top of this page.

Every mirror copies the pages of the original site, keeps their order, and rewrites nothing inside them, so a reader following a link on the mirror lands on the mirror and never on the original.

The directory layout is flat for the guides and nested for the reference, which the sitemap of the mirror lists in full for anyone who wants to crawl it.

A picture of the layout is at in the text of this paragraph.
